🚤 Fewer boats, but bigger ones.

Crossings are down 40% on 2025 so far this year, and I'll always be straight about that. But 1,670 people reached the UK in 23 boats in just four days, with boats now carrying an average of 68 people and launches spreading from Belgium to Normandy.

A lower number isn't a solved problem. Illegal entry must lead to removal, not a hotel room. 👇
